sentences.text: The 2014 floating-rate prepayment-charge circular and the 2025 pre-payment-charge directions are no longer in force on the as-of date.
For cases other than the specific situations in paragraph 261(1) and (2), the current UCB directions say that pre-payment charges, if any, are to be as per the UCB’s approved policy.

I cannot confirm that a 5% foreclosure or pre-closure charge is allowed from the evidence, because the bank’s approved policy is not provided and the applicability of the floating-rate prohibition also needs the facility and sanction date.
